topic: How independent service-based businesses are using AI to cut their cost-per-lead in half
findings: Businesses using AI report up to a 60% reduction in lead generation costs, alongside a 50% increase in sales-ready leads.
AI-assisted outreach paired with human qualification calls cut cost-per-meeting from $312 (early 2025) to $94 (Q1 2026 cohorts) — a 70% reduction.
64% of businesses using AI chatbots report an increase in qualified leads, with real-time interaction boosting B2B conversion rates by up to 20%.
